notes:
Summary: mid-market ecommerce platform (vertical: apparel + seasonal accessories). Running ~8M active SKUs, catalog grows to ~18M SKUs during holiday promotions. Primary ask: replace keyword search + heuristics with semantic search + a dense-retriever + lightweight reranker to improve precision on head queries and long-tail discovery while keeping cost-per-search under tight targets.

Use-case details:
- workload: front-line product search (site search & API), also category landing personalization and promoted items reranking.
- desired flow: embed query -> top-k dense recall (approx 100) -> fast learned reranker (on CPU or small GPU) -> business rules + final re-score.
- qps targets: baseline 120 qps peak, expected seasonal spikes 5x (600 qps).
- latency SLA: p95 end-to-end search < 150ms (customer cares about interactive latency).
- cost target: <$0.004 per query at peak; ideally <$0.002 avg.
- index size: 8M baseline vectors; delta indexing daily; nightly full reindex acceptable but prefer incremental updates.

Technical constraints / preferences:
- prefer dedicated GPU pools for the heavy recall path; reranker should be runnable on cheap CPU instances for cost control + graceful degradation.
- want prefix/KV caching for repeat queries during promotions.
- routing/fallback: prefer regional routing (NA primary, EU replica), automatic fallback to smaller quantized model if capacity constrained.
- model preferences: open models (Llama family variants) for embeddings, 8-bit or 4-bit quantization acceptable. Also willing to test Redwood-verified embeddings vs existing vendor.

Security / compliance:
- must support SSO (SAML), enterprise audit logs, customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest, and data residency for EU customers. Ongoing legal/security review - asked for SOC2 + infra diagram.
